exposure: Dexamethasone as adjuvant to Bupivacaine hydrochloride in TAP Block
Dexmedetomidine as adjuvant to Bupivacaine hydrochloride in TAP Block
outcome: Time for first request of analgesia
cohort: The study included 100 patients undergoing caesarean section, randomized into two groups to receive different adjuvants in a Transversus Abdominis Plane (TAP) block.
finding: Dexmedetomidine was more effective than Dexamethasone as an adjuvant in TAP Block for postoperative analgesia in caesarean section patients, providing better VAS scores and a longer duration of analgesia.
followup_time: Up to 19.66 hours (based on mean time of request for first analgesia in the Dexmedetomidine group)
